title: Islam Beyond Terrorists and Terrorism
subtitle: Biographies of the Most Influential Muslims in History
author: Iftekhar Mahmood
description: Short biographies of influential Muslims throughout history, written to introduce their lives and contributions and to counter the identification of Islam with terrorism.

title: The Rise and Fall of the Islamic Empires
author: Iftekhar Mahmood
description: A concise historical account of Islamic empires. The book also addresses the misconception, after September 11, 2001, that all Muslims are violent or fundamentalist. About 198 pages.

title: Interspecies Pharmacokinetic Scaling
subtitle: Principles and Application of Allometric Scaling
author: Iftekhar Mahmood
description: Practical guide to pharmacokinetic allometric scaling and its use in selecting a first-in-human dose during drug development. Published in Rockville, Maryland; 393 pages.

title: Clinical Pharmacology of Therapeutic Proteins
author: Iftekhar Mahmood (editor)
description: Edited volume on the clinical pharmacology of therapeutic proteins, including pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, analytical methods, allometric scaling, and nonclinical aspects. First edition; 565 pages.

title: Pediatric Pharmacology and Pharmacokinetics
author: Iftekhar Mahmood
description: Covers pediatric pharmacology and pharmacokinetics, including child physiology and issues in pediatric drug development. About 302 pages.

title: Pharmacokinetic Allometric Scaling in Pediatric Drug Development
author: Iftekhar Mahmood
description: Applies pharmacokinetic allometric scaling to dose selection and pediatric drug development. Published in Rockville, Maryland. ISBN-13 is derived from the listed ISBN-10 0976643855.

title: Fundamentals of Pediatric Drug Dosing
author: Iftekhar Mahmood; Gilbert Burckart (editors)
description: Explains how pediatric physiology, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics differ from adults, and how those differences affect selection of a safe and efficacious dose. Hardcover ISBN; ebook ISBN 978-3-319-43754-5. A 2017 paperback reprint also exists.
